grammar.q: Thousands of trees [ ____ ] along the river every spring.
The club members had carefully [ ____ ] a surprise party for their teacher’s retirement.
The ancient coins [ ____ ] by a farmer while he was digging an irrigation channel in his field last year.
Your package [ ____ ] within three working days, even to remote areas.
Lunch [ ____ ] online until 10 a.m., and special meals for allergies are available.
The temple on the hill, which attracts thousands of visitors every year, [ ____ ] in the 14th century.
Plastic waste that ends up in the ocean [ ____ ] a huge number of sea animals every single year.
A sudden increase in the number of visitors [ ____ ] during the summer festival, causing serious traffic congestion in the narrow streets of the old town.
The old bridge connecting the two villages [ ____ ] because last month’s heavy flood caused serious structural damage.
Many students found the lecture on climate change [ ____ ] because it lacked real examples and relied heavily on statistics.
The participants in the study were made [ ____ ] the same task for three hours.
The letters found in a drawer of the old house [ ____ ] by a young soldier to his parents during the Korean War in early 1951.
The problem that the committee discussed at last week’s meeting [ ____ ] at last.
Several species of birds that once lived on this island [ ____ ] over the last century, mainly because of deforestation and hunting.
The audience looked [ ____ ] as the acclaimed scientist walked slowly onto the stage to begin her talk.
Satellite images are used [ ____ ] changes in the size of forests around the world.
The students who were caught cheating on the exam [ ____ ] to see the principal.
The documents stored in the basement of the library [ ____ ] by the flood last spring, so the staff moved the rest to a storage room.
The theory that the young scientist proposed [ ____ ] by substantial data from many countries.
A new recycling center for the whole community [ ____ ] near the river next year to reduce landfill waste.
Hundreds of old trees along the main road [ ____ ] to make room for a parking lot.
The museum’s oldest paintings, which are extremely fragile, [ ____ ] by experts right now.
The findings of the survey on teenagers’ sleep habits [ ____ ] in a medical journal.
A serious error in the computer system [ ____ ] while the students were taking the online exam, and many were unable to save their answers.
The school’s music club [ ____ ] about twenty students from all grades, and its weekly practice sessions are open to any student who wants to join.
Signs of the disease [ ____ ] only after the patients had been exposed to the virus for weeks.
Elderly residents living alone in the village [ ____ ] by local volunteers every weekend.
Her request for a deadline extension on the history report [ ____ ] by the teacher yesterday.
Many people were [ ____ ] to learn how much plastic waste ends up in the ocean each year.
The documentary about the life of honeybees was so [ ____ ] that we watched it twice.
The players felt [ ____ ] after losing the final match by only one point.
The Great Wall is said [ ____ ] the longest structure ever built by human beings.
It [ ____ ] that sleeping less than six hours a night can impair the body’s immune system.
The suspect was seen [ ____ ] the building a few minutes before the fire started.
The workers were made [ ____ ] at the factory until the broken machinery was completely fixed.
People who move to a new country slowly become used to [ ____ ] different kinds of food.
Solar panels on the school roof are used [ ____ ] electricity for the classrooms during the day.
Before smartphones became common, people used to [ ____ ] letters to stay in touch with distant friends.
The firefighter [ ____ ] while rescuing the children was given a special award by the city.
The volunteers [ ____ ] to the ceremony received certificates for their work during the disaster.
A large part of the money raised at the charity event [ ____ ] on books and tuition for children from low-income families in the region.
The cause of the strange noises in the old building [ ____ ] a mystery for many years.
A special prize [ ____ ] the student who had collected the most plastic bottles.

arrange.ko: 시청에 걸려 있는 이 그림은 약 300년 전에 한 유명한 화가에 의해 그려졌다.
arrange.bogi: was painted / hanging in the town hall / by a famous artist about 300 years ago / this picture
arrange.ans: This picture hanging in the town hall was painted by a famous artist about 300 years ago.

arrange.ko: 발표 중에 실수를 한 그 수줍은 소년은 반 친구들에게 비웃음을 당했다.
arrange.bogi: by his classmates / who made a mistake during his presentation / was laughed at / the shy boy
arrange.ans: The shy boy who made a mistake during his presentation was laughed at by his classmates.

arrange.ko: 이번 주말에 전국 각지에서 온 수천 명의 방문객이 그 축제를 찾을 것으로 예상된다.
arrange.bogi: to visit / the festival this weekend / thousands of visitors from all over the country / are expected
arrange.ans: Thousands of visitors from all over the country are expected to visit the festival this weekend.

arrange.ko: 몇 달 동안 매일 영어 일기를 쓰는 것은 너의 작문 실력을 크게 향상시킨다.
arrange.bogi: greatly improves / an English diary every day for a few months / your writing skills / writing
arrange.ans: Writing an English diary every day for a few months greatly improves your writing skills.

arrange.ko: 그 소녀는 전교생 앞에서 무대 위에 혼자 서 있었는데, 목소리가 긴장으로 떨리고 있었다.
arrange.bogi: her voice / stood alone on the stage in front of the whole school, / the girl / shaking with nervousness
arrange.ans: The girl stood alone on the stage in front of the whole school, her voice shaking with nervousness.

arrange.ko: 그 여행 동안 학생들이 찍은 사진들은 다음 주에 학교 웹사이트에 게시될 것이다.
arrange.bogi: will be posted / taken by students during the trip / the photos / on the school website next week
arrange.ans: The photos taken by students during the trip will be posted on the school website next week.

arrange.ko: 캠프 참가자들이 직접 쓴 엽서는 캠프 마지막 날에 우주로 보내질 것이다.
arrange.bogi: will be sent to space on the last day of the camp / written by / the postcards / the campers themselves
arrange.ans: The postcards written by the campers themselves will be sent to space on the last day of the camp.

arrange.ko: 선정된 작품들은 온라인에 전시되고 국제 전시회에서 특별히 소개될 것이다.
arrange.bogi: in international exhibitions / will be showcased online / and featured / selected works
arrange.ans: Selected works will be showcased online and featured in international exhibitions.

arrange.ko: Maggie가 다른 아이들 앞에서 혼자 노래하라는 요청을 받았을 때, 그녀의 목소리는 떨리기 시작했다.
arrange.bogi: her voice started shaking / to sing alone / when Maggie was asked / in front of the other children,
arrange.ans: When Maggie was asked to sing alone in front of the other children, her voice started shaking.

translate.en: However, according to the latest weather forecast, extremely low temperatures are expected throughout Friday. 그러나 최신 날씨 예보에 따르면 금요일 내내 매우 낮은 기온이 예상된다.
translate.ko: 남부 지방에는 다음 주 초까지 폭우와 강풍이 계속될 것으로 예상된다.

translate.en: Spending long hours outdoors under these conditions may be potentially unsafe for students. 이러한 상황에서 장시간을 야외에서 보내는 것은 학생들에게 잠재적으로 안전하지 않을 수 있다.
translate.ko: 실험 전에 설명서를 주의 깊게 읽는 것은 학생들이 실험실에서 많은 위험한 실수를 피하도록 도와준다.

translate.en: Maggie stood up, her hands gripping the seat in front of her. Maggie는 자리에서 일어났는데, 그녀의 손은 앞 좌석을 꽉 붙잡고 있었다.
translate.ko: 그 주자는 결승선을 천천히 통과했는데, 언덕을 한참 올라온 탓에 다리가 떨리고 있었다.

translate.en: During his time at Duke University, he lived in Paris for half a year and became fluent in French, which benefited him in his future work in Haiti. Duke 대학교 재학 중 그는 반년간 파리에 살며 프랑스어가 유창해졌는데, 이는 훗날 아이티에서의 활동에 도움이 되었다.
translate.ko: 많은 학생들이 지난여름 도서관 자원봉사 프로그램에 참여했는데, 이는 도서관을 훨씬 더 깨끗하고 이용하기 좋게 만들었다.

translate.en: Participants will take home a certificate signed by astronauts. 참가자는 우주비행사들이 서명한 수료증을 집으로 가져갈 것이다.
translate.ko: 중앙 홀에 전시된 그림들은 10개가 넘는 나라에서 온 학생들이 만들었다.

translate.en: Maggie stood up, her hands gripping the seat in front of her.
translate.ko: Maggie는 자리에서 일어났는데, 그녀의 손은 앞 좌석을 꽉 붙잡고 있었다.

translate.en: She had never sung alone before, and as she opened her mouth to begin, her voice started shaking.
translate.ko: 그녀는 혼자 노래해 본 적이 한 번도 없었고, 입을 열어 시작하자 목소리가 떨리기 시작했다.

translate.en: A few children turned around to look at her, and her heart began to race.
translate.ko: 몇몇 아이들이 뒤돌아 그녀를 보았고, 그녀의 심장이 빠르게 뛰기 시작했다.

translate.en: She focused hard on the lyrics, trying not to forget the words.
translate.ko: 그녀는 가사를 잊지 않으려 애쓰며 가사에 집중했다.

translate.en: Durwood quietly stood up and began to sing along.
translate.ko: Durwood가 조용히 일어나 함께 노래를 부르기 시작했다.

translate.en: His voice was steady and calm, carrying the song forward.
translate.ko: 그의 목소리는 안정되고 차분했으며, 노래를 이끌어 나갔다.

translate.en: Maggie let out a breath she hadn’t realized she was holding.
translate.ko: Maggie는 자신이 참고 있는 줄도 몰랐던 숨을 내쉬었다.

translate.en: With Durwood singing beside her, the tension in her chest eased.
translate.ko: Durwood가 옆에서 노래를 부르자 가슴 속 긴장이 누그러졌다.

translate.en: She continued the song, no longer frozen, and they finished it together.
translate.ko: 그녀는 더 이상 얼어붙지 않은 채 노래를 이어 갔고, 그들은 함께 노래를 마쳤다.
